comparison.objective: Cover three used batteries and place them in a recycling box; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated cover push-fitting and bin placement versus long-rail regrasping, compliant prong insertion, telescoping alignment, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires every battery covered before entering the box and no drops; candidate requires correct rail engagement and screw-hole use with persistent released support.
comparison.reason: Push-fitting alone is too generic to establish overlap.
